visa.question: What is visa guidance, travel documents, and entry requirements?
visa.answer:
Visa and entry requirements depend on your nationality, residence status, route, travel date, and destination. Travelers are responsible for meeting all applicable visa and entry requirements and should check passport validity and required travel documents before departure.

Infants and children must also have their own valid passport and any required visas. If you need further confirmation, contact Fly Cham before travel with your route, travel date, nationality or residence details, and relevant documents.

airport.question: What is check-in information and airport special assistance services?
airport.answer:
Please arrive at the airport at least three hours before your scheduled departure. For international flights, the check-in counter closes 60 minutes before departure, and passengers arriving late may not be accepted for travel.

Wheelchair assistance can be requested during booking, through Manage Booking, a Fly Cham ticketing or sales office, or Customer Service. Assistance can include support through airport procedures such as security, immigration, and boarding. Medical clearance may also be required for certain medical conditions.

baggage.question: What are baggage allowances, additional baggage options, and fee guidance?

baggage.note: Additional baggage can be purchased in advance during booking or through Manage Booking, subject to availability on your flight. Any applicable additional-baggage fee depends on the baggage option and booking conditions.

hero.title: Things to Do in Damascus
hero.description: Explore iconic landmarks, vibrant markets, and unique local experiences in a city where history, culture, and everyday life come together.
hero.imageAlt: The Umayyad Mosque rising above the rooftops of old Damascus

umayyad.title: Umayyad Mosque
umayyad.description: Built by Caliph Al-Walid I in 705 AD, the Umayyad Mosque stands at the heart of Old Damascus. Its layered sacred history, three distinctive minarets, and remarkable gilded mosaics make it one of the city's most significant architectural and spiritual landmarks. The mosque remains a defining symbol of Damascus, where centuries of faith, culture and artistic heritage come together.
umayyad.imageAlt: The gilded mosaics and courtyard of the Umayyad Mosque

oldCity.title: Old City of Damascus
oldCity.description: Built in the 18th century by As'ad Pasha al-Azm, it showcases elegant courtyards, intricate stonework, and stunning interior details. Today, the palace hosts a museum with displays of traditional clothing, furniture, and artifacts, offering a fascinating insight into the city's history and culture.
oldCity.imageAlt: A traditional courtyard house in the Old City of Damascus

souq.title: Souq Al-Hamidiyah
souq.description: Step into Souq Al-Hamidiyah, one of the oldest covered markets in the world and one of Damascus's most iconic landmarks. Located in the heart of the Old City, it brings together traditional shopping, local crafts, spices, perfumes and historic character in one vibrant passage. Surrounded by major landmarks such as the Umayyad Mosque, Damascus Citadel and nearby heritage souqs, it offers a rich introduction to the culture and everyday life of Damascus.
souq.imageAlt: Shoppers walking through the covered Souq Al-Hamidiyah

cta.title: Find Your Next Flight to Damascus
cta.description: Explore the current schedule for Damascus and choose the travel date that works for you.

hero.title: Flights to Damascus (DAM)
hero.imageAlt: The Umayyad Mosque minaret rising above the old city of Damascus

special.title: What makes Damascus special?
special.description: Travel to the Syrian capital, Damascus, where you'll find a unique blend of culture and history. The city boasts a rich heritage, a distinctive character, and a vibrant atmosphere, making it one of the best destinations in the Middle East.
special.imageAlt: The colonnaded entrance to the Umayyad Mosque in Damascus

cuisine.title: What are the most famous traditional dishes in Damascus?
cuisine.description: Damascus cuisine is one of the oldest and most authentic in the world, and the city's traditional dishes offer a wide variety to suit all tastes. Enjoy the rich flavors of popular local dishes and appetizers, including tabbouleh, yalanji, baba ghanouj, fava beans, kibbeh labneh, and ouzi rice, as well as delicious Damascene sweets like knafeh, madlouqa, maamoul, and more.
cuisine.imageAlt: A Damascene table spread with traditional mezze dishes

places.title: What Are the Best Places to Visit in Damascus?
places.description: There are plenty of fun travel activities to do when you visit Damascus, including great shopping opportunities to find souvenirs and local handicrafts, starting with traditional markets like Souk al-Hamidiyah and Souk al-Buzuriyah. Explore the art galleries, trendy boutiques, and lively cafes of Damascus.

special.title: What makes Dubai special?
special.description: Travel to Dubai, a city unlike any other destination in the world. From towering skyscrapers to traditional markets, it combines luxury with authentic Arabian hospitality.
special.imageAlt: Dubai skyline combining modern towers and the city beyond

places.title: What Are the Best Places to Visit in Dubai?
places.description: Start your visit in Downtown Dubai, which boasts many stunning attractions. Then embark on a journey to explore the city's historic heart, wandering through the Al Fahidi Historical Neighborhood and the famous Gold Souk. Then enjoy a panoramic view of the city from the 148th floor of Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest skyscraper, and watch the stunning dancing water show at the Dubai Fountain. Other amazing attractions include Dubai Miracle Garden, the world's largest natural flower garden, as well as the Burj Al Arab, the Dubai Frame, and the Museum of the Future.
places.imageAlt: Burj Khalifa rising above Downtown Dubai

cuisine.title: What are the most famous traditional dishes in Dubai?
cuisine.description: Dubai is a global destination for food lovers, where authentic traditional Emirati dishes blend with international cuisine. Popular Emirati dishes are characterized by their rich flavors, infused with Gulf spices such as saffron, cardamom, cinnamon, dried lime, and more. Emirati dining is famous for its hospitality, a hallmark of Emirati culture, passed down from generation to generation. We recommend you try the Ghuzi dish, which tops the list of popular dishes served with the sacrificial animal during special occasions. In addition to lamb Machboos, Malh (salty), Yariyur or Jashid, Jami, and Khameer (meat pies). You can also savor gourmet buffets featuring international cuisines like the French, and Asian cuisines.
cuisine.imageAlt: An evening view of Dubai towers and dining districts

activities.title: More Activities to Do in Dubai
activities.description: Spend a wonderful time at upscale hotels, beach clubs, and fine restaurants on the magnificent Palm Jumeirah Island in Dubai. Experience the adventure of a desert safari, sandboarding, or paragliding over the Palm Jumeirah. Don't miss the shopping spree in Al Barsha, which boasts prestigious brand stores and fine dining. If you're a fan of traditional products, we recommend heading to Deira, the oldest district in Dubai, which reflects the city's rich history and is famous for its stunning traditional markets.
activities.imageAlt: Waterfront leisure along a palm-lined Dubai coastline

aboutUs.intro: Fly Cham is a Syrian airline dedicated to connecting Syria with the world through safe, comfortable, and reliable air travel. We are proud of our services and our team that always strives to meet passengers' satisfaction.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to deliver integrated aviation services for both passengers and cargo of the highest quality, in line with international standards. Guided by authentic Syrian hospitality, we provide travelers with safe and comfortable journeys. We strive to reconnect Syrians with their loved ones worldwide, support Syria's reconstruction and economic growth, and promote cultural exchange by expanding travel destinations through strong strategic partnerships.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To be the leading and preferred airline in Syria and the region, offering a distinguished travel experience that connects Syria to the world, blending professionalism with authentic Syrian hospitality, and built on operational excellence and strategic partnerships.
vision.imageAlt: Fly Cham cabin crew beside an aircraft

fleet.title: Our Fleet
fleet.description: Fly Cham's modern Airbus A320 fleet delivers comfort, luxury, and safety on every journey. Meeting the highest international standards, each flight ensures confidence and peace of mind. As the fleet expands, Fly Cham offers more destinations and exceptional travel experiences.
fleet.imageAlt: Interior cabin of a Fly Cham aircraft

safety.title: Safety First
safety.description: We are committed to applying the highest safety standards in all our operations to ensure the comfort and well-being of our customers and employees.

hospitality.title: Authentic Hospitality
hospitality.description: We embody the generosity of Syrian hospitality in every detail, to create unforgettable memories in the skies.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Our responsibility extends beyond the present, as we build a more environmentally and economically sustainable future with every step we take.

customerFocus.title: Customer Focus
customerFocus.description: We place customer satisfaction, hospitality generosity, and passenger comfort first.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: We are committed to constantly striving to provide the best travel experience for our customers, with outstanding performance and meticulous attention to detail.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.description: Our team works with cooperation and passion to provide the highest levels of service and meet your needs, ensuring your comfort throughout the journey.

responsibility.title: Our Responsibility
responsibility.description: Our journey doesn't end in the sky — we believe in supporting communities, creating opportunities for youth, and embracing sustainability in everything we do to make a positive impact and invest in a more sustainable and inclusive future.

mediaTeam.title: Contact Our Media Team
mediaTeam.description: Are you looking for the latest news and information about Fly Cham? The media center provides comprehensive information including the latest news and press releases, photos, and high-quality video clips.
